displayName: PMI KC A4 - Billing containment fired or failed

documentation.content: The protected S52 billing containment either disabled billing or failed to confirm containment. Treat this as Sev-1 and inspect the verified outcome.

conditionMatchedLog.filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.project_id="__PROJECT_ID__" AND resource.labels.location="__REGION__" AND resource.labels.service_name="budget-guardrail" AND (jsonPayload.marker="KILL_SWITCH_FIRED" OR jsonPayload.marker="KILL_SWITCH_DISABLE_FAILED")
